visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with black hair and a black t-shirt stands before a white counter, holding a large red and black Samyang noodle pack. Her facial expression is bright and excited. Behind her, a person in a white shirt holds a white cat near an air conditioning unit. (2) A man in a black t-shirt and blue cap enters the frame, taking the noodle pack. He gestures actively while talking to the girl, who looks up at him smiling. The setting transitions to a modern living room with a couch and TV in the background. (3) Close-up shots show hands opening the red packaging and placing dry noodle blocks into a stainless steel pot of boiling water on a gas stove. The kitchen setting is brightly lit with overhead artificial lights. (4) The girl is seen dancing and clapping in a larger living room area. A television in the background displays a music video with blue and white graphics. She wears plaid pants and appears energetic. (5) The man holds a red sauce packet over a bowl of cooked noodles. He squeezes thick dark red sauce onto the noodles while holding chopsticks. His expression is focused and determined. (6) The girl eats a mouthful of noodles, and her face immediately contorts in pain from the heat. She grabs a black mug of milk. The man follows by taking a large bite of noodles, initially showing no reaction before his eyes widen in a frozen, intense stare.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document a humorous father-daughter challenge of eating extremely spicy Korean noodles, focusing on their contrasting reactions and the comedic payoff of the man's delayed realization of the spice level.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The noodles are the central subject of the challenge, but it is presented as a personal vlog activity rather than a paid promotion.
